notes.title: Tomb Towers is Out of Early Access
notes.content:
With the latest update (v1.0), Tomb Towers is now officially out of Early Access. You can now enjoy the full retro experience that this game provides. This update also includes:

- Minor tweaks to the design of some levels.
- Fix for a bug that results in not getting the "Time Attack" achievement.
- Added an option to choose resolution for full screen and windowed mode.

tags.bug: - Fix for a bug that results in not getting the "Time Attack" achievement.

tags.feature: - Added an option to choose resolution for full screen and windowed mode.

notes.title: Update v0.4
notes.content:
[h1][b]Challenges: [/b][/h1]
- Finishing the game unlocks special challenges for seekers of increased difficulty.
- "Time Attack" challenge has a leaderboard to compare your best speed-run time with your friends or globally.

[h1]This update also has:[/h1]
- Minor level-design adjustments to some levels.
- bug fixes.

notes.title: Update v0.3.2
notes.content:
- Bug fixes.
- Improved controls.
- More tutorials.

notes.title: Update v0.3.1
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where the character voluntarily enters a wall and die.
- Redesigned Secret Room 1 again.
- Added more tutorials.

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug where the character voluntarily enters a wall and die.

notes.title: Update v0.3
notes.content:
[u]This update includes an important change:[/u]
[list]
[*]After losing all lives, you'll get revived at the last level instead of the beginning of the tower. However, there will be a revival count which will cause missing an achievement.
[/list]
[u]Additional changes:[/u]
[list]
[*]First secret room has been redesigned. Few other levels have minor design improvement.
[*]Added a tutorial for the moving platform.
[*]Music does not restart at every level, instead continues where it stopped.
[*] Added 1 achievement.
[/list]

Music does not restart at every level, instead continues where it stopped.

notes.title: Update v0.2
notes.content:
[b][u]Additions:[/u][/b]
- There is now 3 different paces: [u]Slow[/u], [u]Normal (default)[/u], and [u]Fast[/u]. Current pace will be shown in HUD.
- Every outfit has it's own fun animation when button "Adjust Outfit" is pressed.

[b][u]Fixes:[/u][/b]
- Character control responsiveness is much improved.
- Fixed problem that caused "Dark Nightmare" levels to run slow.
